Name: Skell's Bigger Cellar
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][/center][size=3]Expands the cellar and adds an area for crops.
If you upgrade your house to get the cellar and find your casks in the wall, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip Mode[/url] to get them out.[/size]

[size=5]Installation:[/size]
[size=3]
- Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
- Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
- Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
- Launch the game and enjoy! ﻿[/size][size=2]

[/size][size=3]You can check out the rest of my mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/95265773]HERE[/url].[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6. Fixed being unable to plant in the cellar.

Unzip in your Mods folder.
